subject: Renewal kickoff — Novacorp term & capacity planning / QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.inference, marissa.cole@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal kickoff — Novacorp term & capacity planning / QBR scheduling

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the partnership over the last year. Your renewal window comes up at the end of August (term end 2025-08-31). Based on our usage signals, there are a couple things we should align on in the next 4–6 weeks:

- Target commit / capacity for next term (we show a ~30% throughput growth signal across peak hours).
- Desired contract term (12 vs 24 months) and any pricing flexibility for a multi-year commit.
- QBR + renewal review with execs and procurement to lock dates and mutual action items.

To get momentum, proposal: schedule a 60-minute renewal QBR the week of Jul 14 (we can also do Jul 7 if that works better). Please confirm stakeholder list (product/infra, finance/procurement, legal if needed) and any hard constraints. I attached an initial mutual action plan to speed uptakes and capture deliverables.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Who from Novacorp will own procurement conversations?
- Any internal deadlines (budget approval, board cadence) we should know about?

I’ll coordinate an updated pricing worksheet and finalize two proposed QBR slots once I have your availability.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Novacorp_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: procure@novacorp.com, ravi.shah@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 12:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Novacorp term & capacity planning / QBR scheduling

Hi Sergio —

Appreciate the heads-up. High level: we are planning for a ~30% uplift in committed throughput for next term (driven by a new pilot). Procurement (procure@novacorp.com) is now in the loop — they will need updated pricing and our finance team will want a 2–3 week window to approve any multi-year discount.

Questions from my side:
- Can you surface an updated cost-per-token for the proposed uplift and a side-by-side 12 vs 24 month pricing?
- We’ll need SOC2 evidence and a short summary on data retention / egress — procurement will request that for the contract file.

Preferred QBR date: Jul 15 afternoon ET if available. Otherwise Jul 17 morning ET.

I’ll coordinate internally and loop in our legal if we get to term language changes.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform — Novacorp
elena.park@novacorp.com

Novacorp Procurement: procure@novacorp.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>, procure@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Novacorp term & capacity planning / QBR scheduling

Thanks for starting this, Sergio — I’ll own pricing and the renewal playbook for this account. Quick plan:

1) We will produce a pricing comparison (12m vs 24m) and an uplift worksheet by EOD Thu (2025-06-26).
2) Draft a one-page SOC2 + data retention summary for procurement and attach the full report during the QBR.
3) Propose two calendar slots for the QBR so Novacorp can pick:
   - Tue, Jul 15, 2025 — 16:00 ET (60 min)
   - Thu, Jul 17, 2025 — 11:00 ET (60 min)

Action owners:
- Kimberly: pricing / commercial package / DocuSign draft
- Marissa: technical readout and capacity forecasting (will prepare a one-slide throughput forecast)
- Sergio: mutual action plan + stakeholder coordination

I’ve attached the current renewal playbook and will update it with the Novacorp uplift numbers. If procurement needs earlier legal language, flag that and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Account Strategy | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference

Attachments: Renewal_Playbook_v2.pdf (doc stub)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Novacorp term & capacity planning / QBR scheduling

Sergio / team —

Jul 15 at 16:00 ET works for us. Please send a calendar invite and a DocuSign draft for the proposed 12m & 24m options so procurement can pre-review. Procurement has also requested the SOC2 Type II report and a short KMS/key management summary ahead of the meeting — if you can attach the SOC2 PDF to the calendar invite that will speed review.

I’ve added Ravi Shah (ravi.shah@novacorp.com) for finance approvals.

Looking forward — please include the mutual action plan link in the invite.

Thanks,
Elena
